textbookText: Features:

i.Parsa national park is dominated by Churiya hills ranging from 750 m to 950 m, running east to west through the park. ii.It has a subtropical monsoon climate. iii.Its forest is composed of tropical and subtropical types with sal constituting about 90% of the vegetation. iv.It comprises riverine forest comprising khair, silk cotton trees, sal, pines, Sabai grass. v.It conserves various endangered species such as wild Asian elephant, Royal Bengal tiger, Sloth bear, and Leopard. vi.It is home for above 500 species of birds like White breasted kingfisher, Paradise flycatcher, Large racquet-tailed drongo, Golden backed woodpecker, Giant hornbill (Endangered), etc. vii.It is famous for reptiles and different kinds of snakes including common Cobra, Common and banded Krait, Python and King cobra and mammals such as Blue bull, Sambar, Chital, Hog deer, Barding deer, Langur, Rhesus macaques, striped hyena, Jungle cat, and Palm civet.
8. RARA NATIONAL PARK
Area
: 106 sq. km
Established : 1976 A.D.
Location : Mugu and Jumla
Features:
i.Rara national park is the smallest protected area in Nepal.
ii.It is famous for Rara Lake (Mahendra Tal), the biggest lake (10.8 sq. km) and home for snow
trout (Schizothorax oreinus sinuatus), located at the altitude of 2990 m.
iii.It is rich in blue pine, rhododendrons, Blue pine, herbs, marshlands, tussock grasslands, fir,
oak, juniper, hemlock, spruce and birch species.
iv.Its altitude ranges from 2800 m to 4039 m (Chuchemara peak).
v.It is mainly a coniferous forest.
vi.It is home to about 20 different species of mammals such as Musk deer, Himalayan black bear,
Leopard, Jackal, Himalayan tahr, Yellow throated marten, Otter, Wild dog, Common langur.
Rhesus macaque and Red panda.
vii.It conserves 214 species of birds including coots, snow cock, and some species of pheasants,
grebes, mallard, common teal, red-crested pochard, gulls and Gallinaceous birds.
9. SAGARMATHA NATIONAL PARK
Area
Established : 1976 A.D.
Location : Solu-Khumbu
Features:
i.Sagarmatha national park includes the highest peak in the world: Sagarmatha and some
renowned peaks Lhotse, Cho-Oyu, Thamserku, Nuptse, Ama Dablam, Pumori, Kwangde.
ii.It was enlisted in the World Heritage Sites in 1979.
